newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo ends at high vs mark on dollar rise.
newsitem.headline: Escudo ends at high vs mark on dollar rise.

text.p: 1650 GMT - The escudo closed at around its day's high against the mark as a stronger dollar temporarily banished French political worries and doubts about the single currency.
*The escudo finished at 100.66/69 per mark after opening at 100.78/81.
*Dealers said the lira's weakness could block further escudo gains on Wednesday but the dollar was a more significant factor.
